blocking_reasons.reason: The speaker array scheduler must present the start tone simultaneously on all ten calibrated channels and crossfade four speakers per approach. The stereo inspection sources do not implement that physical output.

The speaker array scheduler must present the start tone simultaneously on all ten calibrated channels and crossfade four speakers per approach. The stereo inspection sources do not implement that physical output.
The start tone is an unbundled input. Exact cue gain and probe files, channel gains, calibration and original Octave/Playrec routines are unavailable.
The trial scheduler needs two distinct no-touch families: six probe catches and two tone-only catches per direction. The inspection scheduler only produces the six probe catches.

Exact intertrial interval sampling, between-direction order, keypad key and online response deadline are unreported. The original auditory estimation and familiarization schedules are outside the inspection.
